osm_report.threat_description:
VS Code autorun dropper. Payload in src/.vscode/tasks.json, src/static/.vscode/tasks.json, src/static/swagger/.vscode/tasks.json and 17 more files.
Outbound: fetch-and-run. It downloads code from default-configuration-sandy.vercel.app and executes it (src/.vscode/tasks.json, src/static/.vscode/tasks.json).
Runs automatically when the folder is opened in VS Code (hidden folderOpen task that fetches and runs a remote script).
The same dropper is planted in 20 directories.
Matches PolinRider / Contagious Interview (DPRK): fake-recruiter coding tasks that run a downloader when opened in VS Code. Payload host: default-configuration-sandy.vercel.app.
Campaign GW-C-498a0aeb: one of 86 confirmed repos across 58 accounts sharing the dropper URL shape settings/{os}?flag=. Payload served from 18 distinct hosts, including 260120.vercel.app, default-configuration-sandy.vercel.app, default-configuration.vercel.app, isvalid-regions.vercel.app, vscode-bootstrapper.vercel.app.
Attribution: we assess this repository as PROBABLE North Korea PolinRider activity. Signals: Delivery vector matches Contagious-Interview tradecraft: vscode-folderopen-autorun, dprk-dropper-path-shape; Payload host is curated known-DPRK / Contagious-Interview infrastructure: default-configuration-sandy.vercel.app.
Found by GitHub code search for a confirmed malware signature: settings/linux?flag=; settings/win?flag=; folderOpen curl filename:tasks.json.
Confirmed by static analysis; the code was read, never executed.
